decisions.basis: The NL1 system-initialization clause and the supplied dossier's empty, non-precise model binding.

The supplied facts therefore cannot decide whether the expected initial target is satisfied or violated. A future exact binding could decide the issue, but no such binding is supplied.

decisions.basis: Supplied NL8 clause, exact Accelerating and transition bindings, and deterministic reachability and consumer facts.

The exact state is declared but is unreachable from the top-level initial configuration, and its relevant consumers are likewise unreachable. Its existence and outgoing transitions do not establish operational entry, so they do not rebut the reachability violation.

decisions.basis: Supplied NL9 continuation clause, exact Approaching state binding, lifecycle action fact, and reachability facts.

The exact state is bound, but the supplied lifecycle carrier is the abstract Send action and the dossier does not establish that Send denotes the required continuation behavior. The state is also unreachable, which is supporting context rather than proof of the distinct state-action property. Because the action semantics are not supplied, the obligation cannot be decided.
decisions.violated_obligation: Approaching must perform the required continuing approach behavior.

decisions.basis: Supplied NL10 retention clause, exact Approaching and exit-transition bindings, and transition guard facts.

The exact bound exits are event-triggered and the supplied transition facts provide no guard or readiness condition establishing that retention interval. Merely having the state and outgoing transitions does not satisfy the readiness-bounded retention property. The possibility that exit events encode readiness is unsupported by the supplied facts and is therefore not a competent surviving rebuttal.
decisions.violated_obligation: Approaching must be retained until the supplied readiness condition for stopping or decelerating holds.

decisions.basis: Supplied NL1 route clause, exact Accelerating, InMotion, UnspecifiedInitial, and transition bindings, plus reachable-consumer facts.

issues.basis: NL5 requires the InMotion initial entry to Accelerating. The closed model's exact InMotion initial edge targets the synthetic UnspecifiedInitial state, while Accelerating is unreachable from the top-level initial entry.
issues.expected: The owner-local initial edge for InMotion enters Accelerating.
issues.observed: The InMotion initial edge targets UnspecifiedInitial; Accelerating is not reachable from a top-level initial entry.
issues.reason: The exact owner scope is InMotion and its closed initial edge selects a different target. The separate valid root entry into DoorsClosing does not satisfy this nested owner-local entry requirement.
issues.requirement_quote: The system begins in the Accelerating substate
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The FCSTM contains an InMotion initial edge and Accelerating is declared with the required source identity, but neither fact changes the exact target of the owner-local initial edge.
issues.title: InMotion Enters the Wrong Initial Substate

issues.basis: NL8 requires entry into Accelerating when motion begins and the closed model has no reachable Accelerating state. Its exact consumer transition is present but unreachable because InMotion enters UnspecifiedInitial.
issues.expected: Motion-begin stimulus causes entry into Accelerating.
issues.observed: Accelerating is unreachable from the top-level initial entry; its Reached_Cruising_Cruise and Approached_Decelerate consumers are also unreachable.
issues.reason: The required target state is exact and declared, but the deterministic reachability and consumer facts show that the state cannot be entered during operation from the top-level initial configuration.
issues.requirement_quote: The system enters the Accelerating substate when motion begins
issues.strongest_rebuttal: Accelerating exists and has outgoing transitions, but declaration and local outgoing behavior do not establish that the motion-begin stimulus can reach it.
issues.title: Accelerating Is Not Operationally Reachable

issues.basis: NL9 requires Approaching to continue approaching the destination. The exact closed state has no lifecycle continuation field corresponding to the required continuing action; the supplied inspection facts also show the state is unreachable from initial entry.
issues.expected: Approaching performs the required continuing approach behavior.
issues.observed: The closed lifecycle carrier for Approaching is the abstract Send action, and Approaching is unreachable from the top-level initial entry; the supplied facts do not establish that Send means continuing to approach the destination.
issues.reason: The exact action property is not equated with the separate Send-signal effect obligation. The closed lifecycle carrier does not provide the required semantic continuation, and reachability is supporting behavioral context rather than a replacement property.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The model has a lifecycle action named Send on Approaching, but the supplied source and closed facts do not establish Send as the required continuing approach action.
issues.title: Approaching Lacks the Required Continuation

issues.basis: NL10 requires retention in Approaching while nearing the destination until readiness to stop or decelerate. The closed model provides triggered exits from Approaching for arrival and obstacle events but no supplied guard or trace fact representing the stated readiness condition and retention interval.
issues.expected: Approaching remains active while nearing the destination until the readiness condition for stopping or decelerating holds.
issues.observed: Approaching has event-triggered exits for Arrived_Stop_Send_Arrived and Obstacle_Detected, and the supplied transition facts show no guard or readiness condition on those exits.
issues.reason: The exact retention property is distinct from the existence of the Approaching state or its outgoing transitions. The supplied closed facts do not show the required readiness-bounded retention semantics.
issues.requirement_quote: remains in the Approaching substate while nearing the destination, until it is ready to stop or decelerate
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The model's exit events could be interpreted as operational readiness signals, but the supplied closed transition facts do not establish that interpretation or a bounded retention condition.
issues.title: Approaching Retention Condition Is Not Represented

issues.basis: The exact InMotion event consumers for Reached_Cruising_Cruise are declared on Accelerating, but deterministic reachability facts show no reachable consumer from the top-level initial entry. This is a causal behavioral consequence of the wrong InMotion initial target and is separate from endpoint existence.
issues.expected: The DoorsClosing-to-InMotion behavioral route exposes the Reached Cruising/Cruise response through a reachable Accelerating consumer.
issues.observed: The event has a declared consumer on transition:line:19, but its reachable consumer set is empty because Accelerating is unreachable from the top-level initial entry.
issues.reason: The supplied exact consumer facts distinguish declaration from operational coverage. The candidate is scoped to the required DoorsClosing-to-InMotion route and aggregates the exact unreachable consumer evidence.
issues.requirement_quote: The system begins in the Accelerating substate, moving to the Cruising substate once cruising speed is reached, as indicated by the "Reached Cruising/Cruise" signal.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The transition is declared and carries the corresponding event, but declaration alone does not make its consumer reachable.
issues.title: Cruising Event Consumer Is Unreachable

issues.basis: The exact Approached_Decelerate consumers are declared on Accelerating and Cruising, but deterministic event-consumer facts show that neither consumer is reachable from the top-level initial entry. This is distinct from the endpoint contracts because both endpoint edges exist.
issues.expected: Approached/Decelerate is consumed by a reachable InMotion operating state for the required Accelerating/Cruising alternatives.
issues.observed: The declared consumers on transition:line:20 and transition:line:21 have empty reachable consumer sets because Accelerating and Cruising are unreachable.
issues.reason: The exact event-consumer inventory confirms declaration but no operationally reachable consumer. The candidate preserves the source endpoint locus while reporting the global reachable-consumer gap.
issues.requirement_quote: If the system is in the Accelerating substate and approaches its destination, it transitions to the Approaching substate upon receiving the "Approached/Decelerate" signal.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: Both required transitions exist and carry the event, but their source states are not reachable from the top-level initial entry.
issues.title: Approach Event Consumers Are Unreachable
